answer: Locks are recorded in jetty, expire in knoll, and quill lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 114 aliases thus needs 199 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4965 identities would post 4566 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
